verdict.rationale: OpenCode's IDE docs mention VS Code, Cursor, and general terminal-based IDE support with shortcuts for split-terminal view and file-reference insertion, but there is no mention of JetBrains IDEs specifically, nor of interactive diff viewing within an IDE. missing for 10: any JetBrains-specific integration, interactive diff viewer UI, and evidence of selecting/sharing code as context inside a JetBrains plugin.
